fullTextHeadings.0: Two iconic brands, nearly three centuries of expertise

The bottom line? We are making it easy to do business – with industry-leading service, flexible returns and a lot more:

translations: 圣诞旺季前，商家可通过美国运通 Business Savings Suite 获取 UPS 专属优惠，适用于空运、陆运和国际运输服务。

fullTextParagraphs: Two iconic brands, nearly three centuries of expertise
You heard right: UPS and American Express (Amex) are rolling out new and exclusive offers to support small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs).
UPS U.S. Marketing President Kate Mandrell sat down with Amex President of U.S. Merchant Services Colleen Taylor for a preview of how our collaboration is delivering new benefits to SMBs:

Ahead of the busy Christmas season, merchants can access exclusive savings from UPS via American Express’ Business Savings Suite. That means discounts across our air, ground and international shipping options for SMBs.

“This is often a make-or-break time of year for small businesses,” Colleen said. “It is the perfect time for Amex and UPS to help with the important behind-the-scenes work that makes small businesses run.”
The bottom line? We are making it easy to do business – with industry-leading service, flexible returns and a lot more:
“We manage end-to-end logistics to remove complexity for our customers, creating a frictionless experience for both our customers and their customers,” Kate said.
Did you know? SMBs make up about 30% of the parcels that run through our network with the goal of reaching 35% by 2026.
UPS and Amex are two iconic brands, rooted in trust and reliability, and committed to helping SMBs reach their goals.
With nearly three centuries of expertise between us, there is no better ecosystem for small business growth.
Learn more about our collaboration here.

scenario.title: 虚构情境练习｜介绍合作伙伴的旺季配送优惠
english: A payroll platform and a bank are offering independent retailers a seasonal discount on business payments.
Customers can access the offer through the bank’s small-business portal, and it covers domestic and international transfers.
Write three sentences explaining where to find the offer, what it covers, and how it supports retailers during the busy season.
chinese: 一家薪资平台和银行为独立零售商提供季节性商务付款优惠。
客户可通过银行的小企业门户获取优惠，适用于国内和国际转账。
写三句话说明优惠入口、适用范围，以及它如何帮助旺季经营。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请根据 UPS 与 American Express 于 2025 年 9 月发布的合作公告，给中小企业客户写三句话：说明当年圣诞旺季前从哪里获取优惠、涵盖哪些运输服务，以及这项合作如何帮助商家。
firstAttempt.sample: In its September 2025 announcement, UPS said that ahead of that year’s Christmas season, small and medium-sized businesses could access exclusive UPS savings through the American Express Business Savings Suite. The discounts covered air, ground, and international shipping. The partnership was intended to remove logistics complexity for merchants and their customers.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把入口、运输服务范围和合作带来的帮助说清，同时标明这是 2025 年公告中的旺季优惠。
